errorPage.500.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.500.heading: Internal server error.
errorPage.500.description: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling your request. Please try again later or contact support if the problem persists.
errorPage.404.title: Resource not found
errorPage.404.heading: The page or resource you are looking for could not be found.
errorPage.404.description: It may have been removed, renamed, or is temporarily unavailable. Please check the URL and try again, or return to your dashboard.
errorPage.401.title: Access restricted
errorPage.401.heading: You do not have permission to view this page.
errorPage.401.description: The account you are using cannot access this area. If you believe this is a mistake, return to your dashboard or sign in again with the correct account.
